$comment: Watched areas of the g2way repo. Each area is a set of upstream paths whose content is hashed (git tree/blob OIDs) and recorded in g2way.lock.json. When an area's OID moves, `npm run check:g2way` fails and names the dashboard surfaces that depend on it. Edit `paths` when g2way grows a file this dashboard reads; edit `surfaces`/`onChange` when the dashboard side moves.

surfaces: src/app/api/g2/**
src/lib/g2/**
contracts/g2way.d.ts
areas.onChange: Re-copy the spec and regenerate types; check the BFF proxy allowlist for new or removed endpoints, and where each write reads its org (body org_id vs ?org_id=, ADR-0007).

surfaces: API designer (M3)
Auth editor (M5): authProblems and AUTH_DEFAULTS in src/lib/apis/auth.ts mirror AuthConfig::validate and its serde defaults
areas.onChange: New or changed ApiDefinition fields need form controls, validation and a migration for stored config history.

surfaces: Definition bundle export (M3): src/lib/apis/bundle.ts
areas.onChange: The --apps-dir file layout or accepted extensions moved: check bundleFiles() still writes what load_dir() reads, and the README's duplicate-id caveat.

surfaces: Auth editor (M3/M5)
Request console trace (M5): credentialOf in src/lib/apis/trace.ts mirrors where each auth mode reads its credential
areas.onChange: A new AuthConfig mode needs its own editor branch and an explain-panel entry.

surfaces: Keys and policies (M4)
Access matrix (M4): src/lib/designer/access.ts, src/components/designer/access-matrix.tsx
areas.onChange: Rate/quota/access shape changes ripple into the key editor, the shared access matrix (ApiAccess/TypeFields fields and their help) and the 'what does this key allow' resolver.

surfaces: Visual chain designer (M5): src/lib/apis/chain.ts (CHAIN_SLOTS, chainFor), src/components/apis/chain-view.tsx
Request console trace (M5): inferTrace in src/lib/apis/trace.ts walks chainFor's slots and says what each one did
areas.onChange: The slot order/count is the designer's canonical ordering — re-read the ChainBuilder rustdoc and update it.

surfaces: Middleware designer (M5)
Chain view (M5): applyVersion in src/lib/apis/chain.ts mirrors VersioningConfig::apply
Form checks (M5): TRANSFORM_METHODS and isIpOrCidr in src/lib/apis/auth.ts mirror transform.rs and security.rs

Path-rule editors (M5): ruleProblems, HOP_BY_HOP and MOCK_DEFAULT_STATUS in src/lib/apis/rules.ts mirror PathRule/MockResponse/EndpointRateLimit::validate (endpoints.rs) and UrlRewriteRule::validate (transform.rs)

Versioning editor (M5): versioningProblems, DEFAULT_VERSION_KEY and FORM_OVERRIDES/DEFERRED_OVERRIDES in src/lib/apis/versioning.ts mirror VersioningConfig::validate and VersionOverrides (versioning.rs)

Transform and CORS editors (M5): headerTransformProblems, bodyTransformProblems, corsProblems and the BODY_/CORS_ defaults in src/lib/apis/transforms.ts mirror HeaderTransforms::validate (transform.rs), BodyTransforms/BodyTransformRule::validate (body_transform.rs) and CorsConfig::validate (security.rs)

Request console trace (M5): inferTrace in src/lib/apis/trace.ts mirrors endpoints.rs rule evaluation (block, allow, ignore; first match wins), mock/rewrite/body-rule matching and the version dispatcher's refusals (versioning.rs)

Analytics path templating (M6, ADR-0012 §5): definitionPatterns in src/lib/analytics/path-template.ts reads every regex pattern an ApiDefinition carries (the rule lists, body-transform rules, VersionOverrides) and relies on patterns being searched against the full client path, listen path included
areas.onChange: New transform or rule kinds need editors; check whether validation rules changed. A new VersionOverrides field, or a change to which fields apply() replaces, must be reflected in applyVersion. A new pattern-bearing rule kind belongs in definitionPatterns (path-template.ts).

surfaces: GraphQL studio (M8)
areas.onChange: New execution modes or config blocks need studio support (UDG sources, federation, cache).

surfaces: Plugin manager (M9)
areas.onChange: ABI or PluginRef changes affect upload validation and the documented host interface.

surfaces: Ingest worker (M6, ADR-0012): parseAnalyticsRecord and the hand-written AnalyticsRecord in src/lib/analytics/record.ts mirror crates/g2-core/src/analytics.rs
Rollups (M6): rollupBatch in src/lib/analytics/rollup.ts and the analytics_rollups columns in src/lib/db/schema/
Charts (M6)
areas.onChange: AnalyticsRecord field changes need a parser change in record.ts and, if the field should be charted, a rollup column and a migration. A change to RedisListSink (batching, cap, one list per org) may change ADR-0012's drain assumptions.

surfaces: Ingest worker, direct Redis access (M6, ADR-0012): analyticsRecordsKey in src/lib/analytics/record.ts, and LPOP-with-count/LLEN in src/lib/analytics/queue.ts mirror list_drain in crates/g2-storage/src/redis.rs
Sink name in .env.example, ROADMAP.md and docs/g2way-map.md (AnalyticsSinkKind in config.rs)
areas.onChange: Redis key schema, list_append/list_drain semantics or analytics sink names changed — the ingest worker reads these keys directly.

surfaces: Dashboard manifests (M11)
Request console (M5, ADR-0011): G2_PROXY_URL / G2_ENV_<ID>_PROXY_URL must reach the proxy listener
areas.onChange: Ports, Services or env changed — recheck that the dashboard can still reach the admin API in-cluster.

surfaces: contracts/g2way-docs/
Chain explain panels (M5): SLOT_DOCS and SLOT_ADRS in src/lib/apis/slot-docs.ts cut passages by file and heading (slot-docs.test.ts fails on a renamed one)
explain panels (M8)
areas.onChange: Re-vendor contracts/g2way-docs/; a new ADR may change a decision this dashboard relies on. A moved or renamed doc section needs its SLOT_DOCS entry updated; a new doc about a chain slot deserves one.
